decisions.summary: The Product Owner explicitly approved extending the shared Platform Files contract for the product gallery. Products will consume the shared Files capability; this approval clears only the Files-contract decision and does not authorize Product data writes/migrations or bypass the remaining security/RLS/data gates.

The authorized Platform/DB owner @loopdev-io approved an append-only Products audit event using the existing Platform event envelope, allowlisted metadata (changed field names, version, correlation ID and reason code), no field values/sensitive data, same-transaction persistence with mutation rollback on audit failure, six months active retention, and restricted archive only for documented exceptions. The migration and atomicity tests are implemented and deployed; the approved retention/archive operation still requires verification.

The authorized Platform/DB owner @loopdev-io approved a database-enforced global and per-organization Products write control, default false, checked by every mutation, changed only by Platform/DB owner and audited. It is deployed to loopdev-platform-dev; the global control is false and no organization control is enabled, so remote Products writes remain disabled.

The authorized Platform/DB owner @loopdev-io approved an immutable pre-cutover snapshot and forward-only recovery: disable writes/read-only on failure, repair forward without deleting post-cutover writes, and restore the snapshot only before post-cutover mutations or after reconciliation.

The Product Owner selected a maximum five-minute lifetime for signed media previews. Platform Files returns expiresAt, issues previews only after current authorization checks, and consumers request/renew URLs on demand. The existing Products adapter still uses one-hour URLs until MEDIA-ADAPTER-001 replaces it.

Platform Files owns upload/finalization, server-side image validation, original and 1600/400 max-edge renditions, signed-preview authorization, retention and orphan recovery. ERP owns media tags and Product/SKU assignment/order/alt text; detach removes only an assignment. The generic remote adapter remains future implementation work.

The Product Owner selected a maximum 300-second signed preview URL lifetime. Preview requests include organization/resource context and an explicit original/large/thumbnail rendition; server authorization is rechecked on each issuance. The existing Products adapter remains at 3600 seconds until MEDIA-ADAPTER-001.

Finalized media policy: JPEG/PNG/WebP, maximum 25 MiB, server MIME/signature/decode validation; preserve original and produce 1600/400 max-edge renditions with aspect ratio preserved and no upscale. Platform owns processing/encoding policy, retention/legal hold and orphan recovery; ERP owns tags, assignments, order and per-assignment alt text.

Detach removes only an ERP assignment. Registration/attachment failure never deletes a finalized shared File; cleanup requires Platform reconciliation to verify no active references. The exact retention duration is intentionally left to existing Platform policy.

No shared remote Files adapter or Products media runtime behavior was implemented in this contract task. No remote upload/preview or authenticated Files journey was run; remote Products writes remain disabled.

Attempt 16 completed MEDIA-DATA-001 locally: existing assignments receive deterministic per-gallery positions and version 1; triggers serialize gallery mutations, append new assignments, protect identity and version order/alt-text changes; a deferred unique constraint enforces gallery position uniqueness.

Added a security-checked atomic reorder RPC requiring catalog.write, enabled Products write controls, complete assignment IDs and matching expected versions. Direct clients can update contextual alt text but cannot change position; detach removes only the association.
